description: Own PeopleLive presentation generation and keyed matrix wrapper. Canonical PeoplePermissions validates membership at write boundary rather than duplicated UI membership gate; scope/desired validation remains and rejected client input reloads. Test-first browser regression and existing forged-event LiveView tests. No production test hooks. Update shipped people-access doc.

comments.text: Keyed-wrapper attempt explicitly failed real browsers: stable keyed children retained stale properties and focus regressed. Replaced with stable DOM wrapper + data-generation assign, incremented on each refresh, and a tiny explicitly registered PeoplePermissions updated hook restoring native input.checked from server aria-checked. No remount, no persistence metadata, no mocks/test endpoints. Real failed grant/revoke plus existing keyboard/mobile scenario now PASS all 3 engines (9 tests). Added malformed-state/scope and successful no-op browser cases for both initial ON/OFF states.

Stable wrapper+generation hook passes actual failed write cases in Firefox/WebKit/Chromium; native flip is captured before response, mutation-error flash asserted, property and ARIA restored before reload. Existing Space/focus/mobile test passes. Added malformed desired/scope + no-op coverage both ON/OFF. Follow-up focused run had 8/9 pass, one post-page.reload tab click happened before LiveView reconnect (control absent, reconciliation checks already passed); added existing waitForServerRoundTrip after reload, no retries/time sleeps.
